chunks: And food that will stick in the throat, and painful torment

key_terms.غُصَّةٍ: Food that is hard to swallow or sticks in the throat

ai.seo_question: What is the nature of the food in Hell described in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Muddaththir characterizes the sustenance of the disbelievers as 'ghussah' (a thick, viscous fluid like pus or blood), symbolizing the bitter fruit of their deeds. This physical torment is intrinsically linked to the spiritual anguish of the Hereafter, illustrating how divine justice manifests as a direct consequence of rejecting the truth.
